title: The Line
blurb: The Tether: a rope that climbs spires and swings between roofs.

steps.text: Climb a Tether Spire by rope.
steps.hint: Its platforms answer to a line. The crown pays for the climb.

steps.text: Chain rope zips from ring to ring.
steps.hint: Each ring is a zip from the one below.
The Elder Colossus and the Lumen Spire both have one.
